not_new_principle: The exact gradient split was already saved as a 32-step comparator; full training tests duration/utility. GNCL/block optimization/shared-backbone ensemble objectives are attributed.
mathematical_delta: Relative to own/own, removes only shared grad D. Relative to pool/pool, retains private grad D.
nonconservative: Cross-partial mismatch is -H_theta,phi D; generally not one Euclidean scalar-loss gradient. No global or per-member descent guarantee under simultaneous SGD or native AdamW.
specific_quality_rationale: Train shared capacity for the actually served committee prediction while giving private capacity own-label residuals that can remain large when pooled residuals are small. Utility and competence are empirical.
